==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=NodaTime&min=NodaTime&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/NodaTimeTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=NodaTime&min=NodaTime&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using NodaTime;

// Verify.NodaTime: Snapshots NodaTime types, scrubbing each value to a counter such as LocalDateTime_1 so runs stay stable.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.NodaTime
// Note: VerifyNodaTime.DontScrub() in the module initializer, before Initialize(), turns scrubbing
// off for the whole assembly. It is process wide, so it cannot be toggled per test.
// Note: Turning NodaTime scrubbing off leaves Verify's own date scrubbing in place, so a value
// still reads DateTimeOffset_1 unless DontScrubDateTimes() is called as well.
// Note: This layers on top of Verify's date and time counters rather than replacing them.
// Note: The package targets net48 through net8.0.
public class NodaTimeTests
{
    // A wall clock value changes on every run, so the snapshot would never match. Each distinct
    // value is replaced with a counter, here LocalDateTime_1, which keeps the ordering visible.
    [Fact]
    public Task Scrubbing()
    {
        var target = new
        {
            Dob = LocalDateTime.FromDateTime(DateTime.Now)
        };
        return Verify(target);
    }
}
